regression_found.problem: The CPU production image used two Uvicorn workers while metrics, provider state and the loaded classifier are process-local, allowing requests and metrics reads to observe different state.
regression_found.fix: Use one worker per container for CPU and CUDA production images; horizontal scaling must use separate instances scraped by Prometheus.
regression_found.proof: A live request followed by metrics initially lost the event under two workers and consistently exposed it under one worker; a Dockerfile regression test was added.
